description:
Add one executor accessor that returns, for one issue, the run each of its gate states names, so latest-run readers have one direct lookup to call.

## Background

Three readers select an issue's latest run of a gate from a listing of all its runs and break ties differently (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1241-1252` `get_last_gate_run`, `:1361-1395` `get_last_gate_runs_for_issue`, and `output.rs:1710-1725` `GateView::build`). Each issue's gate state names the latest run of that gate (`GateState.last_run`), and a run record loads by `(issue, run)` through `IssueStore::load_gate_run_result`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CommandExecutor` has one accessor that, for an issue, returns the run each gate state's `last_run` names, one per gate, loading each by `(issue, run)` and listing no runs.
- [hard] REQ-02: Unit tests show that the accessor returns the named run when older runs of the gate exist, and returns nothing for a gate whose state has no `last_run` even when runs of it exist.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: An executor accessor loads an issue's latest run of each gate
